title: ASPB Block Party 2026
description:
ASPB is excited to extend the opportunity for currently enrolled UCR graduate students to purchase a wristband for ASPB Block Party 2026 on Saturday, September 26!

A limited number of 300 wristbands. (first come, first served while supplies last.)

Wristband Cost: $50
Registration Opens: Tuesday, September 1 at 10:00 AM
Registration Closes: Sunday, September 20 at 5:00 PM, or earlier if all available wristbands are claimed.

Before Registration:
Eligible UCR graduate students will already be pre-verified in the ticketing system prior to registration opening.

When accessing the Block Party wristband purchase portal, you must use your UCR student email address in the following format:

firstname.lastname@ucr.edu
Example: jane.doe@ucr.edu

After Purchasing Your Wristband:
Purchasing a wristband is only the first step. Students will also be required to:

• Complete the required pre-concert module
• Attend an official wristband pickup period
• Present their physical UCR student ID and valid government-issued ID
• Bring their physical Block Party wristband and required IDs for entry on event day

There will be no day-of wristband pickup, so please make sure you review and complete all requirements by the posted deadlines.

For the registration link, wristband pickup times, event policies, accessibility information, and additional Block Party details, please visit the ASPB Block Party website.
